No, three of the six services broke the conventions; all three are now fixed in `docker-compose.yml`, though some of the values are my guesses and need your confirmation.

| Service | Problem | Fix | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cache` | no `mem_limit` | `mem_limit: 256m` | my guess |
| `worker` | image tagged `latest` | `stockroom/worker:1.3.2` | matches `VERSION` and the `web`/`api` tags |
| `worker` | no `mem_limit` | `mem_limit: 512m` | my guess |
| `proxy` | image tagged `nginx:latest` | `nginx:1.28.0` | my guess |

`web`, `api` and `db` already complied.

Nothing in the repo indicates the right memory sizes or which nginx version you actually run, so check those three against what is deployed. I did not run `docker compose config` or start anything, and I have not confirmed that a `stockroom/worker:1.3.2` image exists.
